# MIT Sloan Teaching & Learning Technologies

> Central resource hub for MIT Sloan faculty on instructional technology, teaching platforms, generative AI integration, and classroom innovation.

MIT Sloan's dedicated technology support team helps faculty leverage modern teaching tools including Canvas LMS, video recording platforms, and AI applications. The site provides training, guides, and access to state-of-the-art teaching spaces designed for hybrid and interactive learning.

## Key Topics

- Canvas LMS
- Generative AI
- ChatGPT
- Instructional Technology
- Video Recording
- A+ Attendance
- Zoom
- Panopto
- Adobe Creative Cloud
- Teaching Spaces
- Faculty Training
- Course Management
- AI Ethics
- Classroom Technology
- Learning Technologies

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu): Main hub connecting MIT Sloan to instructional technology and teaching resources
- [About Us](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/about): Meet the STS team connecting MIT Sloan to instructional technology best practices
- [Platforms & Tools](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/tools): Overview of teaching platforms and tools including Canvas, A+ Attendance, Adobe

## Teaching with Generative AI

- [Teaching with Generative AI Resource Hub](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/ai): Resource hub for teaching with generative AI, ChatGPT, and AI ethics at MIT Sloan
- [The AI-Ready Canvas Course: Six Steps to Future-Proof Your Teaching](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/2025/05/14/the-ai-ready-canvas-course-six-steps-to-future-proof-your-teaching): Guide to structuring Canvas courses for AI integration and future-proof teaching
- [Simulated Personas, Real Insights: An MIT Sloan Student's Perspective on AI for User Research](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/2025/08/15/simulated-personas-real-insights-an-mit-sloan-students-perspective-on-ai-for-user-research): Student perspective on using generative AI for user research and discovery skills

## Teaching Spaces & Video Production

- [Teaching Spaces](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/teaching-spaces): MIT Sloan's state-of-the-art teaching spaces, reservations, and recording technology
- [Teaching Studio](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/studio): MIT Sloan Teaching Studio for recording live and asynchronous video presentations

## Faculty Training & Support

- [Trainings & Practice](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/trainings): Faculty training workshops for Canvas, Zoom, Panopto, and instructional technology
- [Support](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/support): Help hub for Canvas, Study.Net, and classroom technology with guides and contact
- [Browse Our How-to Guides](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/support/how-to-guides): How-to guides for Canvas, A+ Attendance, Adobe, and classroom technologies

## Reference

- [Calendar](https://mitsloanedtech.mit.edu/calendar): Key dates for course provisioning, term starts, Canvas enrollment, and scheduling
